revisions.title: The credential test
revisions.body: Socrates proposes a credential test: ask who taught a purported expert and what works or pupils can testify to his skill. The pottery analogy makes the standard concrete: we would inspect a potter’s work before entrusting him with a vessel. The passage establishes the test; it does not show that Socrates himself fails it.
